arguments.command: date +%Z && python3 -c "import icalendar; print('icalendar OK')" 2>/dev/null || pip install icalendar pytz 2>&1 | tail -1

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
content = open('project_kickoff.ics').read()
# Basic structural checks
checks = {
    'BEGIN:VCALENDAR': 'BEGIN:VCALENDAR' in content,
    'END:VCALENDAR': content.rstrip().endswith('END:VCALENDAR'),
    'BEGIN:VEVENT': 'BEGIN:VEVENT' in content,
    'END:VEVENT': 'END:VEVENT' in content,
    'VERSION:2.0': 'VERSION:2.0' in content,
    'UID present': bool(re.search(r'^UID:', content, re.M)),
    'DTSTAMP present': bool(re.search(r'^DTSTAMP:', content, re.M)),
    'DTSTART present': bool(re.search(r'^DTSTART', content, re.M)),
    'DTEND present': bool(re.search(r'^DTEND', content, re.M)),
    'SUMMARY present': bool(re.search(r'^SUMMARY:', content, re.M)),
    'balanced BEGIN/END': content.count('BEGIN:') == content.count('END:'),
}
for k, v in checks.items():
    print(f"{'PASS' if v else 'FAIL'}  {k}")
EOF
